description: Django models module defining data models for an e-commerce application, including UserProfile, Item, OrderItem, Order, Address, Payment, Coupon, and Refund, along with related methods and signal handling.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: User profile extending Django's User model with Stripe customer ID and purchasing preferences.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Product item with details like title, price, category, label, description, and image.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents a specific quantity of an Item in an order, with methods for price calculations.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Order containing multiple OrderItems, with status flags, addresses, payment, coupon, and total calculation.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Shipping or billing address linked to a user, with address details and type.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Payment record linked to a user, including Stripe charge ID, amount, and timestamp.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Discount coupon with code and amount.

classes.name: Refund
classes.description: Refund request linked to an order, with reason, email, and acceptance status.

methods.name: get_absolute_url
methods.description: Returns URL for product detail page.

methods.name: get_add_to_cart_url
methods.description: Returns URL to add item to cart.

methods.name: get_remove_from_cart_url
methods.description: Returns URL to remove item from cart.

methods.name: get_total_item_price
methods.description: Calculates total price for quantity of item.

methods.name: get_total_discount_item_price
methods.description: Calculates total discounted price for quantity of item.

methods.name: get_total
methods.description: Calculates total order price including coupons.
